info.title: Providentia API
info.summary: Authoritative Providentia backend contract through the production-readiness programme
info.description:
Bounded identity, multi-home tenancy, published global catalog reads, and home-scoped offline synchronization.

Version 1.4 adds the Phase 5 inventory ledger, counts, purchasing review, shopping lists, and dashboard projections.

Version 1.5 adds privacy-controlled, human-reviewed AI extraction.

Version 1.6 adds sanitized catalog proposals, role-separated moderation, icon metadata, redirects, and reversible product merges.

Version 1.8 adds email-only login-link authentication and durable encrypted notification delivery.

Version 1.9 adds revisioned household permissions, revocable invitations, and accepted ownership transfer with step-up confirmation.

Version 1.10 adds typed pantry synchronization, catalog sharing/imports, data rights, commercial controls, multi-provider AI orchestration, encrypted private media, and production acceptance surfaces.

Version 1.11 adds cross-device login-link approval with origin-client polling and PKCE exchange, current-user bootstrap, recipient invitation acceptance, platform-administrator management, and explicit sliding-session metadata.

Version 1.11.1 exposes the installation UUID separately from the account-scoped device UUID so clients can validate login-link session binding without rejecting valid sessions.

Version 1.12 publishes only moderator-approved, consent-bound catalog contribution facts through a bounded attribution-free global projection.

Version 1.13 adds revision-bound, idempotent stock-count cancellation to the online API and protocol-v2 synchronization command set, publishes a precise AI media-handling disclosure that distinguishes transient direct extraction from explicit encrypted private-media storage, and provides a typed, deterministic, paged home item master for offline caching.

Version 1.13.1 documents the non-disclosing 404 response used when a home is revoked or foreign, allowing clients to purge stale private projections instead of retrying indefinitely.

Version 1.13.2 exhaustively documents non-disclosing home authorization for AI and shopping operations and adds a revisioned receipt-line unresolved decision across ordinary HTTP and protocol-v2 synchronization; receipt commit processes approved lines while retaining unresolved raw lines without price or stock effects.

Version 1.14 adds revision-bound home-private categories and products to the local-first inventory protocol, plus a privacy-safe Linux administrator control plane for account lifecycle and platform roles. Billing enforcement remains disabled by configuration during the free stabilization phase.

Version 1.15 adds consent-bound product-image contributions with server-side sanitization, encrypted moderation quarantine, reviewer-only no-store previews, explicit curator publication, immutable content-addressed public assets, and typed published catalog search results.

202.description: Generic accepted response whether the account is new or already exists

post.summary: Start a login-link request owned by the originating client
post.description: Accepts client-generated polling and PKCE challenges, queues a single-use email approval link, and returns generic request metadata only. Account existence is never disclosed, and the server never returns the private poll token or PKCE verifier. The browser approval does not receive a session; after approval, the originating client exchanges its private proof for the session.

202.description: Accepted without revealing whether the account already exists

post.summary: Poll a login-link request from its originating client
post.description: The private poll token is submitted in the request body and must never be placed in a URL. This operation never returns access, refresh, session, approval, or PKCE credentials.

post.summary: Exchange an approved login-link request for an origin-device session
post.description: Requires the originating client's private poll token, state, and RFC 7636 verifier. Exchange is single-use and terminal; after an ambiguous or lost success response the client must start a new login-link request because credentials cannot be reconstructed from stored hashes. No session credential is accepted in a URL.

200.description: Native credentials or secure cookie session issued to the originating client

202.description: A single-use confirmation link was queued

200.description: Native credentials or secure cookie session issued

post.summary: Revoke a session using current access or refresh possession proof
post.description: Native clients may send their current rotating refresh token. Web clients use the HttpOnly refresh cookie plus the matching CSRF header/cookie. A valid access credential remains accepted. Cookies are cleared on every response.

204.description: Proven session revoked or already inactive; cookies cleared

401.description: No valid session-possession proof; cookies cleared

403.description: Web CSRF proof rejected; cookies cleared

204.description: Password changed and all sessions revoked

get.summary: Bootstrap the authenticated user and current session
get.description: Returns the verified account, current session, active home, and every home membership needed to restore a client without making authorization assumptions.

get.summary: List active and pending platform-administrator grants

post.summary: Grant platform-administrator access by verified email address
post.description: Invitation-by-email workflow: creates an active grant for an existing verified account or a pending grant for an address that has not completed login-link verification. Active grants and revocations advance the same account revision used by the UUID-based account role operations; idempotent requests do not. This global role never creates or implies access to a home.

201.description: Active or pending platform-administrator grant created

post.summary: Revoke an active or pending platform-administrator grant
post.description: The final active platform administrator cannot be revoked. A stale expected revision fails without changing the grant.

patch.summary: Rename a home or update its regional defaults
patch.description: Requires home.manage and optimistic concurrency through expectedRevision.

202.description: Deprecated compatibility route; an accepted ownership proposal was created

200.description: Ownership proposals visible to the participant

201.description: Ownership proposal created after step-up confirmation

204.description: Recipient accepted and ownership changed atomically

201.description: Expiring single-use invitation created and mailed

get.summary: List pending invitations addressed to the verified current account
get.description: Returns only unexpired invitations for the authenticated user's verified email address. Possession of an email token is not required.

post.summary: Accept a pending invitation addressed to the current account

post.description: Deprecated compatibility endpoint. Verified clients should list invitations from /api/v1/me/home-invitations and accept by invitation ID.

200.description: Updated sharing consent and immutable receipt
Exact replay of an existing consent-bound contribution

post.summary: Submit one consent-bound product image for moderation
post.description: The server verifies the exact client digest, distrusts and re-encodes JPEG, PNG, or WebP input as metadata-free WebP, and stores the sanitized bytes in encrypted moderation quarantine. The stable submission identifier makes an exact retry idempotent; changing the source, consent revision, rights declaration, image digest, or normalized metadata produces a conflict.

sourceEntityId.description: An active private product belonging to this home. Its identifier is never exposed in the moderator or public projection.

sourceDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes before server re-encoding.

image.description: One JPEG, PNG, or WebP image no larger than 5 MiB.

200.description: Exact replay of the existing image contribution

201.description: Sanitized image encrypted in pending moderation quarantine

200.description: Moderator-approved global facts without household, user, source, consent, or reviewer attribution.

put.summary: Link an approved product contribution to one governed proposal
put.description: Curator-only, revision-bound and idempotent. The selected published category is explicit; exact retries return the same link. Canonical publication still requires the existing proposal decision operation.

200.description: Existing or newly created durable proposal link

get.description: Reviewer-only binary preview of the sanitized WebP held in moderation quarantine. The response is never cacheable and contains no home or contributor attribution.

put.summary: Publish an approved contribution as a product image
put.description: Curator-only, revision-bound publication. The selected canonical product and icon revision are explicit. An exact retry returns the same publication; a stale or different target fails closed.

200.description: Existing or newly created attribution-free image publication
Idempotent replay of an existing stage
Decrypted Providentia export; the token is consumed atomically

202.description: Verified event accepted or duplicate acknowledged

200.description: Ordered changes through a frozen high-water cursor

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque signed snapshot page cursor from the preceding bootstrap page.

200.description: Consistent authorized current-state snapshot and captured cursor
Device-scoped immutable operation receipts and unknown placeholders

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable operation identifier for exactly-once movement creation.

200.description: Balances rebuilt from the append-only ledger
Open count cancelled without creating inventory movements
Receipt committed and approved lines applied once
Household AI provider profiles without credential material

delete.description: Immediately removes the encrypted credential from an active household provider profile under revision control. A policy may continue to reference the profile, but provider use then fails closed until a new credential is supplied. Repeating a completed request with its old revision returns a revision conflict; deleting an already-clear profile at its current revision is an idempotent no-op.

200.description: Credential revoked; encrypted material is never returned

targetId.description: Optional for receipt intake because the draft receipt is created only after human review. Required for stock intake and must identify an open same-home count session. If supplied for a receipt, it must identify a same-home draft receipt.

images[].description: Additional observations. Send each file as a repeated multipart part named exactly images[]; PHP normalizes those parts into the server-side images array.
